verdict.rationale: Missive's own MCP server lets external AI agents such as Claude, ChatGPT or Cursor act on conversations, contacts, calendar and drafts "with the permissions you choose." That is a first-party way to limit what an agent can do. Beyond that one changelog line, the pack gives no detail on how credentials are issued or scoped. The OAuth custom-scopes option applies to Missive connecting out to other MCP servers, so it does not count here. Missing for 10: documented per-token or per-key permission scopes for REST API credentials, detail on what the MCP permission choices cover (read/write, per resource), separate credentials per agent and revoking them, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
